------Introduction------

This is my little Stardew Valley pet project for an NPC portrait overhaul.

I hope to maybe do all the NPCs, but this mod serves as a little tracker for myself to keep track of my versions and iterations.
This is the first time I am venturing into pixel art, so constructive criticism is welcome!

[b]If you find any portrait bugs please let me know: It's hard to test for everything! [/b]I have completed most of the game, so checking for everything is difficult in my game files' current state.

Being an artist and always being critical of my art, [i]expect many different iterations and updates to the portraits: [u]Nothing is ever perfect for me[/u][/i]. ;)[/center]

[center]------Installation------[/center]

Just extract the file then copy the file into your Stardew Valley Portrait directory!
For example: C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\Portraits
